inference.preprocessing: Official installed VGGT-Omega balanced loader; native source PNGs identical to Surflo/VGGT.
inference.comparison_resolution_note: Omega resolution budget 256; actual input height/width [224, 288]. Earlier model input dimensions are stored in the parent geometry_batch.pt.
inference.coordinate_frame: Omega predicted camera frame, arbitrary scale; separate gauge from VGGT/Surflo. No GT geometry or ICP.

mesh.mesh_protocol: Per-view depth-grid triangles; no cross-view stitching; use labeled relative-confidence preview mask and discard edges longer than 5% of local predicted depth. This mesh is derived visualization geometry.
